subject: Renewal + capacity bump — billing setup, PO & EFT details
messages:
From: Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@auroradw.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + capacity increase — next steps for PO/finance

Hi Priyom / Marissa,

We reviewed the renewal proposal and would like to move forward with the 12-month renewal plus a +40% committed capacity bump on Dedicated. Procurement is ready to issue a PO but needs a couple things from your side before we route internally: an invoice remittance name/address, your current W-9 (or tax docs), and EFT routing instructions. Also confirm whether Redwood can accept Net45 on the renewal invoice (our standard).

I attached a short PO request doc that our AP team fills in (Aurora_PO_Request_0507.docx). Can you confirm what billing contact we should list and whether electronic signature via DocuSign is fine for the SOW/amendment?

Thanks,
Sara Bennett
Director, Finance — Aurora DataWorks

Attachments: Aurora_PO_Request_0507.docx

From: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@auroradw.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — next steps for PO/finance

Hi Sara — thanks for the note and for the clear checklist. Congrats on the expansion — excited to keep building with Aurora.

Quick answers:
- Billing remittance: Redwood Inference, Attn: Finance — billing@redwoodinference.com (I'll confirm mailing address below).
- W-9 and EFT: looping in Neha from Billing Ops to provide the W-9 and wire details.
- DocuSign: yes, DocuSign is fine. We can do the SOW amendment via DocuSign once the PO is in place.
- Net45: marking for finance review — I have looped in Rishi and Neha. Please attach the PO PDF when available (we can provisionally accept the PO number to start the amendment).

Proposed next steps:
1) Aurora sends PO PDF (procurement@auroradw.com).
2) Neha will send a pro-forma invoice + W-9 + EFT instructions.
3) We issue the amendment via DocuSign and schedule a short kickoff for Dedicated capacity increase (ops).

Deal id: D-78-aurora-2027 — I will update HubSpot.

Best,
Priyom Das
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Kevin Liu <kevin.liu@auroradw.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@auroradw.com>
Date: 2027-05-21T08:24:00-07:00
Subject: Aurora PO attached — question on net terms

Hi Priyom / Sara,

Attached is the official PO for the renewal + capacity increase (Aurora_PO_20270521.pdf). Our AP team’s standard terms are Net45; we can annotate Net30 if Redwood requires, but that requires approval from our CFO (slower). We can accept DocuSign and will include the PO number on the invoice. Please confirm acceptance of Net45 and provide bank routing so we can set up EFT.

PO number: AUR-2027-0421
Contact for AP follow-up: procurement@auroradw.com

Thanks,
Kevin Liu
Sourcing Manager — Aurora DataWorks

Attachment: Aurora_PO_20270521.pdf

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-21T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora PO attached — question on net terms

Priyom / Neha —

Net45 is acceptable for strategic renewals where it offsets revenue risk (we’ve done Net45 for similar customers). Two operational notes:
- Finance will approve Net45 for this renewal given the committed bump and annual term, but we need a signed amendment and the PO on file before provisioning expanded Dedicated capacity.
- Neha: please prepare a pro-forma invoice that marks Net45 and includes the PO number (AUR-2027-0421). Add standard late-payment clause and remittance address. Also include electronic W-9 (we'll send Redwood_W9_2027.pdf).

I'll ask Ops to tentatively schedule the Dedicated capacity increase for June 7th — contingent on signed amendment/PO.

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kevin Liu <kevin.liu@auroradw.com>, Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@auroradw.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora PO attached — Pro-forma, W-9 & EFT details

Hi Kevin / Sara —

Thanks — we received the PO and can accept Net45 for this renewal. Please see attached:
- Redwood_W9_2027.pdf (tax form)
- Redwood_EFT_Instructions.pdf (bank routing + remittance email)
- Proforma_Invoice_Aurora_20270522.pdf (shows Net45, PO AUR-2027-0421)

Next steps for Aurora AP:
1) Confirm PO number on your side (AUR-2027-0421) and confirm billing contact for remittance.
2) Once confirmed, Priyom will route the amendment via DocuSign; sign + return.
3) We’ll provision the Dedicated capacity bump on or after the effective date on the signed amendment (Marissa noted tentatively June 7th).

Bank routing (summary): Redwood Inference / First Union Bank — account ending ****1234. Full details in the EFT PDF. Remittance address: Redwood Inference, Attn: Accounts Receivable, 1212 Market St., San Francisco, CA 94103.

Let me know if you need ACH vs wire instructions or if the PO needs any changes.

Best regards,
Neha Kapoor
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_W9_2027.pdf; Redwood_EFT_Instructions.pdf; Proforma_Invoice_Aurora_20270522.pdf

From: Sara Bennett <sara.bennett@auroradw.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Kevin Liu <kevin.liu@auroradw.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aurora PO attached — Pro-forma, W-9 & EFT details

Neha — thanks for the fast turnaround. We confirm receipt of the W-9 and EFT details. AP has the PO number AUR-2027-0421 on file and will queue payment under Net45.

I'll accept the amendment via DocuSign as soon as Priyom sends it; target to sign this week so Ops can start provisioning on June 7th. Appreciate the clear instructions — I'll email procurement@auroradw.com to finalize internal routing.

Best,
Sara Bennett
Director, Finance — Aurora DataWorks
